label: EWSR1::ERG

sections.text: EWSR1 encodes an RNA-binding protein whose amino-terminal region can activate transcription.
ERG encodes an ETS-family transcription factor involved in vascular and hematopoietic development.

The fusion links the EWSR1 amino-terminal transcriptional activation region to an ETS-family DNA-binding region, creating an oncogenic transcription factor that reprograms cell identity. EWSR1::ERG is a recognized Ewing sarcoma fusion.
